title: Why You Should Add a Home Security System Installation to Your Wedding Registry
summary: A smart home security system can help you start your new life together with total peace of mind. Learn how.
body_markdown:
When you’re adding smart home security to your wedding registry, don’t forget to add Arlo Secure. It’s our AI-powered security platform that unlocks even more value for your entire home security system.


With Arlo Smart Aware, you get instant access to a fully searchable 60-Day Video History, complete with automatically generated Event Captions. You’ll also get customizable Smart Activity Zones so your family can capture and get notified for the most essential events while filtering out the noise. And our Early Warning System levels up your entire security stance by recognizing specific people, vehicles, fires, sounds, and even custom events, notifying you instantly to give you the information you need to react.


Upgrade to Arlo Smart Secure, and get the deluxe, hands-on security treatment. You’ll get 24/7 Professional Monitoring and 24/7 Emergency Response, so if something happens around your house and you’re not around to step in, our licensed Safety Agents will be there to respond for you. And with all plans, you’ll get Priority Care from our team of experts to help you get the most out of your new security system.


Don’t put security off until after the wedding. Add Arlo cameras and[Arlo Secure](https://us.arlo.com/pages/arlo-secure) to your wedding registry today, and make peace of mind a priority for your new life together.
